Welcome to saber ! How may I help you?

The OP Billing service module acts as a single billing point for charging all OP services provided by the hospital to outpatients. It generates different bill charges based on eligibility criteria and allows for the re-printing of all OP service bills. The Service Billing Advanced form is used for performing the billing process in a hospital, where most billing activities are conducted. You can view the patient visit history through this form.
